verdict.rationale: Parsec is a remote-desktop SaaS with a Teams API, not an agent itself, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for this kind of product and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or any agent-connection endpoint. The Teams API is a developer building block for deployment automation and does not count as an MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
